                    STATE OF FLORIDA
        PUBLIC EMPLOYEES RELATIONS COMMISSION

                CERTIFICATION OF REPRESENTATIVE

The Commission certifies the Petitioner as the exclusive bargaining
representative of the general employees unit.

DATED June 14, 2011, at Tallahassee, Florida.

                ORDER AMENDING CERTIFICATION

The unit description is amended to add the classification of dispatcher.

DATED March 2, 2016, at Tallahassee, Florida.

                FINAL ORDER REVOKING CERTIFICATION

No collective bargaining agreement has been filed. Certification No. 1032
is hereby REVOKED.

DATED 09/18/2019, at Tallahassee, Florida.
